meta.name: secrets-management
meta.description: Implement secure secrets management for CI/CD pipelines using Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or native platform solutions. Use when handling sensitive credentials, rotating secrets, or securing CI/CD environments.

copy.tagline: 保护 CI/CD 流水线中的敏感凭据免遭泄露
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在 CI/CD 中管理密钥却担心泄露风险
copy.tagline_en: Secure sensitive credentials in your CI/CD pipelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle secrets in CI/CD and worry about leaks

howto.what: 装上后,当 Claude 处理 CI/CD 密钥时,它会给出 Vault、AWS Secrets Manager 或平台自带密钥工具的存取、轮换与泄露扫描示例。
howto.when: 当用户提到 API 密钥、数据库密码、TLS 证书等敏感凭据,或要求轮换密钥、加固 CI/CD 环境时。

say.text: 帮我把数据库密码存进 Vault,代码里别写明文。
say.note: Claude 会给出 Vault 配置和存取命令。

say.text: 给 GitLab CI 加密钥扫描,防密钥进仓库。
say.note: Claude 会提供 TruffleHog 扫描配置。

howto.what_en: When handling CI/CD secrets, Claude outputs configuration and code examples for HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, native platform secrets, secret rotation, and secret scanning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions sensitive credentials such as API keys, database passwords, or TLS certificates, requests secret rotation, or asks to secure a CI/CD environment.

say_en.text: Please store the database password in Vault, not as plaintext in code.
say_en.note: Claude shows Vault setup and store/read commands.

say_en.text: Read the production database password from AWS Secrets Manager in GitHub Actions.
say_en.note: Claude gives get-secret-value code plus masking.

say_en.text: Add secret scanning to the GitLab CI pipeline.
say_en.note: Claude provides a TruffleHog scanning job.
